data.mechanism: EXIST trials: everolimus shrank the brain tumours (SEGA) and kidney lesions of tuberous sclerosis - treating the pathway the mutation switches on, rather than a downstream symptom. The gene defect itself remains.
data.mechanism_beginner: In patients with the genetic disease tuberous sclerosis, everolimus shrank both brain and kidney tumours. It works one step downstream of the mutation: it replaces the brake the mutation removed, so the tumours shrink while the drug is given and regrow when it stops. The mutation itself is untouched.
data.boundary: Lesions regrow when the drug is stopped - this is suppression, not cure.
data.note: The purest case in the Atlas: known gene, known pathway, matched drug, randomised evidence.
